newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hangzhou Steam Turbine to offer 100 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Hangzhou Steam Turbine to offer 100 mln B shares.

text.p: Hangzhou Steam Turbine Co Ltd plans to issue 100 million B shares and use the proceeds to upgrade production technology and facilities, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The firm, based in Hangzhou, capital of eastern Zhejiang province, is among the 33 domestic enterprises approved this week to list B shares by the Securities Commission of the State Council, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The firm has not decided where it would apply to list the B shares, the official said, adding that the timing and pricing of the issue have not yet been fixed.
The company is in the process of selecting a domestic lead underwriter and an international coordinator for the issue, he said.

The firm has a total share capital of 120 million state shares owned by the Hangzhou Steam Turbine Power Group Co Ltd and had unaudited after-tax profits of 49.80 million yuan for 1996 and 28.56 million yuan for 1995, the official said.
The company's products are widely used in China's fertiliser and power plants, he said, without giving more details.
